message.text:
I am examining the CreateMemo handler to locate the webhook dispatch call. I will also check whether HMAC-SHA256 is handled by a standard library or implemented manually.

The dispatch function is `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook`. The delivery package is `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/webhook`. The signing mechanism is HMAC-SHA256 per the Standard Webhooks spec.

The handler is `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. It calls `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` from `internal/webhook`.

No external Standard Webhooks library exists. The code implements HMAC-SHA256 itself. It sets the `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` headers.
